entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: An elf, high-ranking priest and acting Guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave, a close friend of Jace Beleren and an advocate of guild cooperation.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of nature and community that Emmara serves, led by the dryad Trostani.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled plane where Emmara lives and serves.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker, Emmara's close friend, who once used the name Berrim and became Ravnica's Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The three-headed dryad guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrives with a wounded Jace and clashes with Emmara.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Master of the Infinite Consortium who tortured Jace and sent an assassin.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: A cabal led by Tezzeret that Berrim became interested in.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of mages whose search Emmara was told to investigate.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The secretive guild that follows Emmara and manipulates events.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The guild of hedonists manipulated by the Dimir into seeking Jace and Emmara.

entities.name: Varolz
entities.description: A Golgari figure who ambushes Jace.

entities.name: Mirko Vosk
entities.description: A Dimir figure who gravely wounds Emmara.

entities.name: Captain Calomir
entities.description: Emmara's paramour and Selesnya captain, actually Lazav in disguise.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A Dimir shapeshifter who took Calomir's place months earlier.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon who reveals the Implicit Maze's secrets and is later resurrected as Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who confronts Jace at the Izzet Guildgate.

entities.name: Exava
entities.description: A Rakdos figure who confronts Emmara at the guildgate.

entities.name: The Implicit Maze
entities.description: A guild-run maze whose route is revealed by Jace and which would wipe out the guilds if activated.

entities.name: Living Guildpact
entities.description: The Ravnican title tied to the Guildpact, held by Jace and later Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Azorius leader murdered at the guild summit.

entities.name: Garo
entities.description: A Selesnya glademaster revealed to be in league with Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker whose invasion of Ravnica triggers the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who seeks Selesnya help to revive Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Teyo
entities.description: A character in Kaya's party.

entities.name: Rat
entities.description: A character in Kaya's party.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: Murders at Karlov Manor
entities.description: A murder case in which Trostani was implicated.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The Selesnya's guild-spirit with which Trostani confers.

events.summary: After the Guildpact's dissolution riots, Emmara survives as a healer in Ovitzia and befriends the young telepath Berrim.
events.quote: she met a young telepath named Berrim

events.summary: Berrim asks about the Infinite Consortium and Emmara warns him, but he ignores her.
events.quote: she knew that he'd ignored her warnings

events.summary: Years later Emmara heals the tortured Berrim, then Jace arrives bleeding with Liliana Vess; Tezzeret's assassin interrupts and Jace decides to attack Tezzeret.
events.quote: Emmara healed him and once again urged him to leave

events.summary: Trostani commands Emmara to investigate the Izzet and gives her command of the conclave's elementals; she forgives Jace, but House Dimir has followed her.
events.quote: House Dimir had already followed Emmara, and she had led them right to Jace.

events.summary: Jace erases his memory of the Izzet's secrets as Emmara watches helpless, and the Rakdos come for them.
events.quote: she was left helpless as she watched him destroy his knowledge

events.summary: Emmara goes willingly with the Rakdos, escapes to the Golgari sewers, and saves Jace from Varolz, but the Dimir strike.
events.quote: Using her power over elementals, she saved her friend

events.summary: Mirko Vosk gravely wounds Emmara; at Vitu-Ghazi Jace meets Captain Calomir, cannot read him and is thrown out of Conclave territory.
events.quote: he was quickly thrown from Conclave territory

events.summary: Calomir overrides Emmara's fears and Trostani calls for war; Emmara agrees to summon the greater elementals.
events.quote: she agreed to summon the greater elementals of the Selesnyan Conclave

events.summary: The Selesnya march on the Rakdos and into the Boros Legion; Niv-Mizzet reveals the maze's secrets, Emmara is arrested for treason and learns from Jace that Lazav replaced Calomir.
events.quote: she learned that Lazav had taken Calomir's place months ago

events.summary: Emmara exposes Lazav but sows dissent; she runs the maze with Jace until Ral Zarek makes Jace reveal his lies at the Izzet Guildgate.
events.quote: she lured Lazav and managed to expose him

events.summary: At the Rakdos guildgate Emmara withstands Exava's demons until Trostani arrives with reinforcements.
events.quote: Trostani arrived with reinforcements, apologetic for the trials Emmara had suffered

events.summary: At the Forum of Azor Lazav influences the runners, but Jace's telepathy stops the Maze, triggering the Supreme Verdict that makes him Living Guildpact.
events.quote: This triggered the Supreme Verdict , which made Jace Ravnica's new Living Guildpact .

events.summary: Emmara asks Jace to erase her memory of the other worlds and who he was, and he agrees.
events.quote: She asked him to erase that memory from her mind, and sadly, Jace acquiesced.

events.summary: As Trostani is divided and Garo is revealed as Bolas's ally, Emmara steps forward to lead the Conclave and pursue guild peace.
events.quote: Emmara stepped forward to fill the void in leadership

events.summary: Emmara attends the guild summit for the Conclave and witnesses its dissolution after Isperia's murder.
events.quote: witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia

events.summary: Emmara first declines Kaya's plan to revive Niv-Mizzet, but Harmony wakes and the Selesnya join the fight against Bolas.
events.quote: Harmony, the middle Trostani, finally woke up and decided that Selesnya would be joining the other guilds to defeat Bolas.

events.summary: Emmara represents the Selesnya at Niv-Mizzet's resurrection; three years later she regains control of the guild when Trostani is implicated in the Karlov Manor murders.
events.quote: Tandris regained control of the guild
